role.label: Entity Shell Company

role.label: Entity Small Business

role.label: Entity Voluntary Filers

role.label: Fair Value Disclosures [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for the fair value of financial instruments (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined), and the measurements of those instruments as well as disclosures related to the fair value of non-financial assets and liabilities. Such disclosures about the financial instruments, assets, and liabilities would include: (1) the fair value of the required items together with their carrying amounts (as appropriate); (2) for items for which it is not practicable to estimate fair value, disclosure would include: (a) information pertinent to estimating fair value (including, carrying amount, effective interest rate, and maturity, and (b) the reasons why it is not practicable to estimate fair value; (3) significant concentrations of credit risk including: (a) information about the activity, region, or economic characteristics identifying a concentration, (b) the maximum amount of loss the entity is exposed to based on the gross fair value of the related item, (c) policy for requiring collateral or other security and information as to accessing such collateral or security, and (d) the nature and brief description of such collateral or security; (4) quantitative information about market risks and how such risks are managed; (5) for items measured on both a recurring and nonrecurring basis information regarding the inputs used to develop the fair value measurement; and (6) for items presented in the financial statement for which fair value measurement is elected: (a) information necessary to understand the reasons for the election, (b) discussion of the effect of fair value changes on earnings, (c) a description of [similar groups] items for which the election is made and the relation thereof to the balance sheet, the aggregate carrying value of items included in the balance sheet that are not eligible for the election; (7) all other required (as defined) and desired information.

role.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 1 [Member]
role.documentation: Quoted prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities that the reporting entity can access at the measurement date.

role.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 2 [Member]
role.documentation: Inputs other than quoted prices included within level 1 that are observable for an asset or liability, either directly or indirectly, including, but not limited to, quoted prices for similar assets or liabilities in active markets, or quoted prices for identical or similar assets or liabilities in inactive markets.

Disclosures include, but are not limited to, how an entity that manages a group of financial assets and liabilities on the basis of its net exposure measures the fair value of those assets and liabilities.

role.documentation: Categories used to prioritize the inputs to valuation techniques to measure fair value.

role.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Accumulated Amortization
role.documentation: Amount of accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

role.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, after Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

role.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, Year One
role.documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

role.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

role.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, Year Four
role.documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

role.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, Year Three

Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

If a reporting lag exists, the closing date of the entity having a different period end is generally noted, along with an explanation of the necessity for using different closing dates. role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for goodwill and intangible assets. This accounting policy also may address how an entity assesses and measures impairment of goodwill and intangible assets.

role.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation, Gain (Loss)
role.documentation: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

role.documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of income taxes previously overpaid to tax authorities (such as U.S. Federal, state and local tax authorities) representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes. Also called income tax refund receivable.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

role.terseLabel: Expected income tax provision at federal statutory tax rate
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
role.documentation: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Benefit related to research and development tax credits
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

role.terseLabel: Cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds received
role.label: Income Tax Paid, after Refund Received
role.documentation: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

role.terseLabel: Income Tax Paid, after Refund Received [Abstract]
role.label: Income Tax Paid, after Refund Received [Abstract]
Income Taxes Receivable, Noncurrent
role.documentation: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Trade
role.documentation: Change in recurring obligations of a business that arise from the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services used in the production and sale of goods and services.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

role.label: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital [Abstract]
Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

role.terseLabel: Dilutive common share equivalents included in diluted shares
role.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-Based Payment Arrangements
role.documentation: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

role.label: Inland Revenue, Singapore (IRAS) [Member]
role.documentation: Designated tax department of the government of Singapore.

role.label: Insider Trading Policies and Procedures [Line Items]

role.terseLabel: Insider Trading Policies and Procedures Adopted
role.label: Insider Trading Policies and Procedures Adopted [Flag]

role.terseLabel: Insider Trading Policies and Procedures Not Adopted
role.label: Insider Trading Policies and Procedures Not Adopted [Text Block]
Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, before Accumulated Amortization
role.documentation: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

role.label: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, after Accumulated Amortization
role.documentation: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Interest expense
role.label: Interest Expense, Operating and Nonoperating
role.documentation: Amount of interest expense classified as operating and nonoperating. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of borrowing accounted for as interest expense.

role.label: Interest Rate Swap [Member]
role.documentation: Forward based contracts in which two parties agree to swap periodic payments that are fixed at the outset of the swap contract with variable payments based on a market interest rate (index rate) over a specified period.

role.terseLabel: Interest paid related to commercial paper and long-term debt, net of cash received from the related interest rate swaps
role.label: Interest paid net of interest received
role.documentation: Interest paid on debt, net of interest received from related interest rate swaps.

role.label: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) [Member]
role.documentation: Designated tax department of the United States of America government entitled to levy and collect income taxes from the entity.

role.label: Inventory, Finished Goods, Net of Reserves
role.documentation: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods held by the company that are readily available for sale.

role.label: Inventory, Net
role.documentation: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Inventory, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of inventory accounting policy for inventory classes, including, but not limited to, basis for determining inventory amounts, methods by which amounts are added and removed from inventory classes, loss recognition on impairment of inventories, and situations in which inventories are stated above cost.

role.label: Inventory, Raw Materials, Net of Reserves
role.documentation: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of unprocessed items to be consumed in the manufacturing or production process.

role.label: Inventory, Work in Process, Net of Reserves
role.documentation: Carrying amount, net of reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods which are partially completed. This inventory is generally comprised of raw materials, labor and factory overhead costs, which require further materials, labor and overhead to be converted into finished goods, and which generally require the use of estimates to determine percentage complete and pricing.

role.label: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend
role.documentation: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

role.label: Investment Income, Nonoperating
role.documentation: The aggregate amount of income from investments (for example, dividends) not considered a component of the entity's core operations.

role.label: Investment Income [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of investment income, including, but not limited to, interest and dividend income and amortization of discount (premium) derived from debt and equity securities. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investments.

role.terseLabel: Investments Classified by Contractual Maturity Date
role.label: Investments Classified by Contractual Maturity Date [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of maturities of an entity's investments as well as any other information pertinent to the investments.

role.label: Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
role.documentation: Fair value portion of investment securities, including, but not limited to, marketable securities, derivative financial instruments, and investments accounted for under the equity method.

role.totalLabel: Carrying value of equity method and non-marketable equity investments
role.label: Investments in and Advance to Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures
role.documentation: Amount of investment in equity method investee and investment in and advance to affiliate.

role.label: IoT [Member]
role.documentation: IoT

role.label: Land
role.documentation: Amount before accumulated depletion of real estate held for productive use, excluding land held for sale.

role.label: Leasehold Improvements, Gross
role.documentation: Amount before accumulated depreciation of additions or improvements to assets held under a lease arrangement.

role.label: Leasehold Improvements [Member]
role.documentation: Additions or improvements to assets held under a lease arrangement.

role.label: Legal Costs, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for legal costs incurred to protect or defend the entity's assets and rights, or to obtain assets, including monetary damages, or to obtain rights.

role.label: Lessee, Lease, Description [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Lessee, Lease, Description [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about lessee's leases.

role.label: Lessee, Leases [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for leasing arrangement entered into by lessee.

role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Maturity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of undiscounted cash flows of lessee's operating lease liability. Includes, but is not limited to, reconciliation of undiscounted cash flows to operating lease liability recognized in statement of financial position.

role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.negatedTerseLabel: Imputed interest
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Renewal Term
role.documentation: Term of lessee's operating lease renewal, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.terseLabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Term of Contract
role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Term of Contract
role.documentation: Term of lessee's operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Liabilities
role.documentation: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

role.label: Liabilities and Equity
role.documentation: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

role.label: Liabilities, Current
role.documentation: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

role.terseLabel: Total liabilities measured at fair value
role.label: Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
role.documentation: Fair value of financial and nonfinancial obligations.

role.terseLabel: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
role.label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
role.documentation: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

role.label: Licensing Agreements [Member]
role.documentation: Rights, generally of limited duration, under a license arrangement (for example, to sell or otherwise utilize specified products or processes in a specified territory).

role.label: Licensing Revenues
role.documentation: Revenue earned during the period relating to consideration received from another party for the right to use, but not own, certain of the entity's intangible assets. Licensing arrangements include, but are not limited to, rights to use a patent, copyright, technology, manufacturing process, software or trademark. Licensing fees are generally, but not always, fixed as to amount and not dependent upon the revenue generated by the licensing party. An entity may receive licensing fees for licenses that also generate royalty payments to the entity.

role.terseLabel: Line of Credit Facility, Covenant Compliance
role.label: Line of Credit Facility, Covenant Compliance
role.documentation: Identification of whether the entity has been in compliance with any credit facility debt covenants during the period.

role.terseLabel: Line of Credit Facility, Fair Value of Amount Outstanding
role.label: Line of Credit Facility, Fair Value of Amount Outstanding
role.documentation: Fair value of the amount outstanding under the credit facility.

role.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
role.documentation: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

role.label: Litigation Case [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of judicial proceeding, alternative dispute resolution or claim.

role.label: Litigation Case [Domain]
role.documentation: Judicial proceeding, alternative dispute resolution or claim. For example, but not limited to, name of case, category of litigation, or other differentiating information.

role.label: Local Phone Number
role.documentation: Local phone number for entity.

role.label: Long-Term Debt
role.documentation: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities
role.documentation: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Fair Value
role.documentation: The fair value amount of long-term debt whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
role.documentation: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
role.documentation: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
role.documentation: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
role.documentation: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
role.documentation: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

role.label: Long-Term Purchase Commitment [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Long-Term Purchase Commitment [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about long-term purchase arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, term of arrangement with supplier, minimum quantity required, milestone, period covered by arrangement, and committed amount. Excludes short-term purchase arrangement and unconditional purchase obligation.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Type [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of long-term debt.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Type [Domain]
role.documentation: Type of long-term debt arrangement, such as notes, line of credit, commercial paper, asset-based financing, project financing, letter of credit financing. These are debt arrangements that originally required repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the company, if longer.

role.label: Loss Contingencies [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Loss Contingencies [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about loss contingency. Excludes environmental contingency, warranty, and unconditional purchase obligation.

role.terseLabel: Loss Contingency, Estimate of Possible Loss
role.label: Loss Contingency, Estimate of Possible Loss
role.documentation: Reflects the estimated amount of loss from the specified contingency as of the balance sheet date.

role.label: Machinery and Equipment, Gross
role.documentation: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

role.label: Customer [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by name or description of a single external customer or a group of external customers.

role.label: Marketable Securities, Current
role.documentation: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as current.

role.label: Marketable Securities [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Marketable Securities, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for investment classified as marketable security.

role.label: Marketable Security, Realized Gain (Loss)
role.documentation: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

role.label: Marketable Securities [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about investment in marketable security.

role.label: Segment Reporting, Reconciling Item, Excluding Corporate Nonsegment [Member]
role.documentation: Items used in reconciling reportable segments' amounts to consolidated amount. Excludes corporate-level activity.

role.label: Maximum [Member]
role.documentation: Upper limit of the provided range.

role.label: Minimum [Member]
role.documentation: Lower limit of the provided range.

role.terseLabel: MNPI Disclosure Timed for Compensation Value
role.label: MNPI Disclosure Timed for Compensation Value [Flag]
Mobile handsets [Member]
role.documentation: Mobile handsets

role.label: Modular [Member]
role.documentation: Modular

role.label: Mortgage- and asset-backed and auction rate securities [Member]
role.documentation: Mortgage- and asset-backed and auction rate securities [Member]

role.terseLabel: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Movement in Valuation Allowances and Reserves [Roll Forward]
role.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Movement in Valuation Allowances and Reserves [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.label: Material Terms of Trading Arrangement [Text Block]
Customer [Domain]
role.documentation: Single external customer or group of external customers.

role.totalLabel: Net cash used by financing activities
role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

role.totalLabel: Net cash used by investing activities
role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

role.totalLabel: Net cash provided by operating activities
role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]
Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
role.documentation: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

role.terseLabel: Net gains on deferred compensation plan assets
role.label: Net (losses) gains on deferred compensation plan assets
role.documentation: Net (losses) gains on deferred compensation plan assets

role.label: New Accounting Pronouncements, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy pertaining to new accounting pronouncements that may impact the entity's financial reporting. Includes, but is not limited to, quantification of the expected or actual impact.

role.terseLabel: Non-PEO NEO Average Compensation Actually Paid Amount
role.label: Non-PEO NEO Average Compensation Actually Paid Amount

role.terseLabel: Non-PEO NEO Average Total Compensation Amount
role.label: Non-PEO NEO Average Total Compensation Amount
Non-US [Member]
role.documentation: Countries excluding the United States of America (US).

role.label: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
role.documentation: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

role.label: Business Combination, Number of Businesses Acquired
role.documentation: Number of businesses acquired in business combination.

role.label: Number of Reportable Segments
role.documentation: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

role.label: Operating Expenses
role.documentation: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

role.label: Operating Income (Loss)
role.documentation: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

role.label: Operating Lease, Expense
role.documentation: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.

role.label: Operating Lease, Liability
role.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

role.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
role.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

role.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
role.documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes current operating lease liability.

role.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
role.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

role.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
role.documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes noncurrent operating lease liability.

role.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

role.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
role.documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes operating lease right-of-use asset.

role.terseLabel: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
role.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
role.documentation: Weighted average remaining lease term for operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards
role.documentation: Amount of operating loss carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

role.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards, Valuation Allowance
role.documentation: The portion of the valuation allowance pertaining to the deferred tax asset representing potential future taxable deductions from net operating loss carryforwards for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

role.label: Operating Segments [Member]
role.documentation: Identifies components of an entity that engage in business activities from which they may earn revenue and incur expenses, including transactions with other components of the same entity.

role.label: Organization, Consolidation, Basis of Presentation, Business Description and Accounting Policies [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for the general note to the financial statements for the reporting entity which may include, descriptions of the basis of presentation, business description, significant accounting policies, consolidations, reclassifications, new pronouncements not yet adopted and changes in accounting principles.

role.label: Other Assets, Current
role.documentation: Amount of current assets classified as other.

role.label: Other Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
role.documentation: Fair value portion of other assets.

role.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
role.documentation: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

role.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Net of Tax
role.documentation: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

role.terseLabel: Net unrealized (losses) gains on derivative instruments
role.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, after Tax
role.documentation: Amount, after tax and before reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

role.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
role.documentation: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

role.terseLabel: Other comprehensive (loss) income, net of income taxes:
role.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax [Abstract]
Other Comprehensive Income, Other, Net of Tax
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in other comprehensive income, after tax, from changes classified as other.

role.terseLabel: Net unrealized (losses) gains on certain available-for-sale debt securities
role.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
role.documentation: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

role.label: Other Currency [Member]
role.documentation: Currency classified as other.

role.label: Other Current Liabilities [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of other current liabilities.

role.label: Other Foreign [Member]
role.documentation: Other Foreign [Member]

role.label: Other Intangible Assets [Member]
role.documentation: Intangible assets classified as other.

role.label: Other Liabilities
role.documentation: Amount of liabilities classified as other.

role.label: Other Liabilities, Current
role.documentation: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Other Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
role.documentation: Fair value portion of other liabilities.

role.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)

role.terseLabel: Warrant Shares, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate
role.documentation: The estimated measure of the percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.
